column1: # Victorian postcodes that hold only post office boxes (or reply paid), with no
# street address in G-NAF and no ABS postal area, mapped to the G-NAF locality
# they are delivered at. Each row was checked against the source URL on the
# retrieved date; add a row only from a source you have read, and only when the
# source names a G-NAF locality (Australia Post names many CBD box postcodes
# after their post office, e.g. 8003 COLLINS STREET EAST, which are left out).
